subject: Re: Labspark bake-off — request for trial credit top-up
messages:
From: Alex Cho <alex.cho@labspark.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Labspark bake-off: request for additional trial credits

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the Redwood latency profile looks promising for our use case. We need to confirm token allocation before the vendor evaluation next week. The selection committee expects parity testing against two competitors; our scoring window runs Oct 6–9.

Can Redwood increase our trial allocation by ~200k tokens (we'll run high-concurrency side-by-side tests)? Procurement may also ask for a short SLA addendum for the test window. I've attached the RFP summary and scoring rubric.

Samantha (cc) will handle procurement questions. Can you confirm by EOD Thursday?

Cheers,
Alex
Alex Cho
Head of ML Infrastructure, Labspark AI
alex.cho@labspark.ai
attachments: Labspark_RFP_requirements.pdf, RFP_scoring_matrix.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Cho <alex.cho@labspark.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Labspark bake-off: request for additional trial credits

Alex —

Appreciate the context and the timeline. Short answer: we can support an additional allocation for the bake-off, but I need to align on two items before we commit:

- Exact throughput (avg tokens/sec) and expected concurrent sessions during the test window
- Whether you need dedicated priority capacity (we can reserve a burst pool for the week)

Options we can offer quickly:
- Conditional top-up: 200k tokens and high-priority support during Oct 6–9 (no contractual SLA change)
- Reserved burst: additional cost + formal SLA addendum (requires Procurement sign-off)

Ben — looping you in to confirm any deal-level concessions we should hold to. If Procurement pushes for an SLA addendum we'll need to surface to Legal/RevOps; I'll attach a quick usage report after initial runs so Ben can review budget impact.

I can confirm a draft by EOD tomorrow if you provide the concurrency numbers.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
attachments: trial_usage_report.csv

From: Alex Cho <alex.cho@labspark.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@labspark.ai>, Procurement <procurement@labspark.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Labspark bake-off: request for additional trial credits

Thanks Kimberly — quick answers:

- Expected concurrency: 12 parallel sessions, peak bursts up to 20 for short intervals. Average throughput per session ~ 30 tokens/sec (evaluation prompts are short).
- We'd prefer the conditional top-up with priority support; Procurement may request the SLA addendum if we pick Redwood for Prod. For the bake-off though, a priority pool is sufficient.

Procurement note: we prefer vendor confirmations in writing for audit; can Redwood provide a short note stating the top-up and support commitment? That will help speed approval.

Alex

On Wed, Sep 30, 2026 at 9:12 AM Alex Cho <alex.cho@labspark.ai> wrote:
> (attached RFP and rubric)

attachments: RFP_scoring_matrix.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T13:37:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Labspark bake-off: request for additional trial credits

Kimberly —

I'm okay to approve a conditional top-up for Labspark up to 200k tokens, with these guardrails:

1) Top-up valid for Oct 6–9 only. Unused tokens expire after the window.
2) We provide priority support (Slack escalation + 2 on-call engineers during the window).
3) If Procurement requests an SLA addendum, Legal needs to review — that would be a separate ask and may require terms + a PO.
4) No price discount or credits against future committed spend without Sales leadership sign-off.

Marissa / Mateo: please confirm operational readiness for reserved burst and that the running cost won't exceed internal thresholds. If Ops signs off, Kimberly, send a one-line commitment to Labspark that lays out 1–3 above; include DocuSign link if they want a short addendum.

Ben Carter
Director, Customer Growth — Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Cho <alex.cho@labspark.ai>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@labspark.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Labspark bake-off: request for additional trial credits

Alex / Samantha —

Confirmed: Redwood will provide a conditional top-up of 200,000 trial tokens scoped to the evaluation window Oct 6–9. We'll also provision a reserved burst pool and priority support (Slack escalation + on-call engineers) for that period. Unused tokens will expire after Oct 9.

If Procurement wants an SLA addendum we can do a short DocuSign addendum limited to the bake-off dates — this would be a simple one-page attachment covering availability and response times for the test window. I've attached a redline to the standard SLA for your review and included a DocuSign link to execute if needed.

DocuSign (optional): https://www.docusign.com/LSK-2026-019/exec

Please confirm acceptance of the terms and I'll unlock the tokens and schedule the Ops reservation.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
attachments: Draft_SLA_redline.docx
snippet: Conditional top-up of 200k tokens approved; priority support included for Oct 6–9, SLA addendum optional via DocuSign.
